description: This Swift source file defines a VoiceWakeManager class responsible for managing voice wake-up functionality using speech recognition and audio input. It includes audio buffer management, permission handling, and command extraction based on trigger words. The code is contextually tied to iOS development with AVFoundation and Speech frameworks.

classes.name: AudioBufferQueue
classes.description: Manages a queue of audio buffers with thread safety for enqueueing and draining audio data.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManager
classes.description: Handles voice wake-word detection, speech recognition setup, permission requests, and command processing.

methods.name: makeAudioTapEnqueueCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback function to enqueue audio buffers into the buffer queue.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an AVAudioPCMBuffer, copying its channel data.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the voice wake-up listening process, including permission checks and audio session configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the voice wake-up process, tearing down speech recognition pipeline.

methods.name: suspendForExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Temporarily suspends listening for external audio capture requirements.

methods.name: resumeAfterExternalAudioCapture
methods.description: Resumes listening after external audio capture suspension.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts command strings from recognized transcripts based on trigger words and segments.
